children: Brookfield agreed to acquire Reliance Worldwide for US$3.38 per share, valuing the company at about US$2.8 billion.
Brookfield will acquire 100% of Reliance Worldwide in an all-cash proposal of US$3.38 per share.
The proposal implies an enterprise value for Reliance of approximately US$2.8 billion.
Reliance Board unanimously recommended the offer; shareholders will vote on the agreement.
Transaction funded by Brookfield Capital Partners and affiliate Brookfield Business Corporation; closing expected in Q1 2027, subject to approvals.
Reliance is a global market leader in push-to-connect plumbing fittings with growth opportunities across Americas, EMEA and APAC.
